regions.merged_text: I almost forgot to tell you that having left Detroit the convert darkies returned after plus three years - three of them instead of two. The good God had blessed them with a decidedly promising young- ster, the picture of his appreciative Daddy. .... I hope that may offer you an example from which to draw a practical lesson. - one case in thousands. Thanks be to God.
